patch.summary:
Choose Later only if your buying job matches “Visual-first social scheduling for Instagram-centric brands — Starter/Growth/Scale plans w” rather than Switcher Studio's shape. Choose Switcher Studio only if your buying job matches “Multi-camera live video production and multistreaming for Mac/iOS marketers — Studio Seaso” rather than Later's shape. Workflow advantage: Later leans social-media-marketing; Switcher Studio leans creator-marketing. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.
